aggregation.formula: sqrt(sum(w_i * c_i^2) / sum(w_i)) over vector, lexical, conceptual

bands_describe: measured text movement only; not materiality, compliance outcome, urgency or risk

conceptual.method: deterministic legal-cue proxy (obligation, permission, prohibition, penalty, scope cue groups x70; numeric change +20; 'shall not' polarity +10; -ize/-ise normalised) or a schema-validated evidence-bound LLM score when available

lexical.method: 100 x (1 - (0.55 x token-set Jaccard + 0.45 x token-sequence similarity))

vector.method: 100 x (1 - cosine) of deterministic 256-dimension feature-hash token vectors; not a pretrained semantic encoder

missing_component_policy: a missing component and the overall score are reported as unavailable with a reason; nothing is substituted
reliability_policy: reported separately; never folded into drift and never called accuracy
unit_of_analysis: one provision-aligned before/after clause pair selected for the question
